result.summary: Found 3 visual issues: unreadable promo banner text due to white-on-light background, blurry low-quality thumbnails in Fastest carousel, and inconsistent wishlist icon styling.

issues.description: Promo banner text '3 free deliveries for you' and 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' is white on very light mint green, resulting in extremely low contrast and barely readable text
issues.suggestion: Use a darker text color or darken the banner background to meet WCAG AA contrast requirements

issues.description: Thumbnail images in 'Fastest near you' carousel appear heavily blurred, pixelated and low-resolution compared to the rest of the UI
issues.suggestion: Replace with high-resolution, properly focused restaurant images

issues.description: Wishlist heart icons in 'Popular right now' cards are inconsistent - first card has transparent background with white outline, second card has dark circular background
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent style with dark scrim behind the heart icon for visibility on all cards
